# Skills Index (Claude → Copilot Bridge)

Use these existing Claude skills instead of duplicating behavior in Copilot. Copilot users: read a skill before running similar tasks.

- add-feature: `../../.claude/skills/add-feature` — scaffold a feature with validation in a worktree.
- refactor: `../../.claude/skills/refactor` — structured, test-preserving refactors.
- debug: `../../.claude/skills/debug` — repro → narrow → root cause → fix → regressions.
- add-test: `../../.claude/skills/add-test` — add unit/component tests with happy/edge/error cases.
- fix-build: `../../.claude/skills/fix-build` — resolve build/TS errors by category.
- update-deps: `../../.claude/skills/update-deps` — systematic dep updates with validation.
- e2e-test: `../../.claude/skills/e2e-test` — generate Playwright tests with selectors via data-testid.
- document-feature: `../../.claude/skills/document-feature` — produce developer/user docs and checklist.
- add-api-route: `../../.claude/skills/add-api-route` — add API routes with validation.
- add-component: `../../.claude/skills/add-component` — create React component + tests.
- add-hook: `../../.claude/skills/add-hook` — create custom React hook + tests.
- audit-and-fix: `../../.claude/skills/audit-and-fix` — security audit and fixes.
- perf-audit: `../../.claude/skills/perf-audit` — profile and optimize.

Tip: If a skill changes, treat it as the source of truth. Copilot docs should link here, not copy content.
